notes.title: Small Update: Quick Retry
notes.content: When the run is over, you can hit 'R' in order to skip the score screen and start a new run immediately.

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.content: Fixed a problem that caused a lot of stuttering

notes.title: October Update
notes.content:
After getting positive feedback on the initial release, I was inspired to spend October adding some extra content to the game. Most notably, two more texts:

- The Wonderful Wizard of Oz
- Peter Pan

And a few extra things:

- Run stats
- More achievements
- New menu tracks
- Palette
